s01_01.text: Hello, friends! Today we learn about our body!

s01_02.text: Beep beep! Let's play copy me!

s08_03.text: I eat and talk with my mouth!

s09_01.text: Can you open your mouth wide?

s09_02.text: Aaah! And now a big smile!

s12_01.text: I have two feet. I jump with my feet!

s17_01.text: Tweet! The sun is going down.

s17_02.text: I can see it with my eyes!

s18_01.text: Hello, friends! I have eyes and a mouth, too!

s22_01.text: Eyes to see. Ears to hear. A nose to smell.

s22_02.text: A mouth to eat. Hands to clap. Feet to walk.

s23_01.text: Thank you for playing copy me!

s23_02.text: Beep beep! Time to go home!
